description: Baseline capability for the host agent window. Custom hardware/config commands do not need plugin permissions. Tray, menu, and hide-to-tray are Rust-side only (setup + CloseRequested). Firecracker, QEMU, PowerShell, and tailscale are spawned from Rust std::process::Command, not the Tauri shell plugin — do not add shell/sidecar permissions. The webview still has no image, menu, tray, resources, or shell permissions.
